question: Which complete native attention/MLP responses outside the old five-source set carry the missing is/was-v15 behavior, and at what cumulative depth does the full causal effect become observable?
population: Exactly all 16 A1 and 16 A2 target rows frozen by the v15 capability manifest; zero fitting or row selection.

interventions.singletons: Complete donor response at each of 36 native sites attn:0,mlp:0,...,attn:17,mlp:17, installed over every aligned position through the semantic endpoint.
interventions.prefixes: For each layer l=0..17, jointly install complete donor attention and MLP responses at every layer 0..l; selection is not used during execution.
interventions.controls: All-site base self-patch, all-site donor patch, and the old MLP0/1/2/3/6 whole-response arm.

response_blocks: the complete 1152-dimensional final-residual donor difference at the semantic endpoint

predictions.pred_a_authority_population_closure_fini: All hashes and exact 16+16 inventory match; base-self and all-donor closures are <=1e-4; all metrics are finite; exactly 59 native forwards execute.
predictions.pred_b_old_five_behavior_replays: The old five-MLP complete arm reproduces the prior is/was behavior projection .3985174 within 1e-5.
predictions.pred_c_new_module_outside_old_five_is_ma: At least one singleton outside MLP0/1/2/3/6 has absolute mean behavior recovery >=.10 with >=.75 rowwise causal direction.
predictions.pred_d_proper_prefix_restores_behavior_a: A cumulative prefix ending no later than layer16 reaches behavior projection >=.75, >=.90 direction, and final-residual RSE <=.20.
predictions.pred_e_final_state_enriches_behavioral_l: Across 36 singleton modules, Spearman correlation between absolute behavior recovery and absolute final-residual signed projection is >=.40.

terminal_policy.localized_new_module: A-C pass and the largest singleton behavior recovery is >=.50.
terminal_policy.distributed_changed_graph: A-D pass but no singleton reaches .50.
terminal_policy.proper_prefix_interaction_failure: A-B pass but D fails even though the all-site donor control closes.

next_branch: Split the top causally live attention module into all nine heads, or split a top MLP by construction-stable causal response modes; if support is distributed, execute a frozen greedy composition of the top complete modules.
